core_obligations: Set-up (proof lines 3872-3881): E = t(s^{-1}(W)) is set-theoretically R-invariant (03LO) and contained in a quasi-compact W' (0APA); T = t(s^{-1}(Z)) for Z = U \ W' satisfies Z subset T and E cap T = empty since s^{-1}(E) = t^{-1}(E) is disjoint from s^{-1}(Z).

Invariance of the closure (proof lines 3883-3893): points of T-bar are specializations of points of T (02JQ, 01R8); lifting along flat s (03HV) shows the t-image of the lifted specialization lies in T (03LO invariance), so T-bar is set-theoretically R-invariant.
Conclusion (proof lines 3892-3894): V = U \ T-bar is the desired open, with W subset V (W subset E and E is open-disjoint from T, hence from its closure) and V subset W'.
proof_roadmap: Produce E and W' and the disjointness E cap T = empty (proof lines 3872-3881).
Show T-bar is set-theoretically R-invariant by specialization lifting (proof lines 3883-3893).
Read off V = U \ T-bar with the required inclusions (proof lines 3892-3894).
